summary: All assets are on-campaign and retail-suitable. One official LEGO® brand logo and three distinct LEGO® Pokémon™ physical product sets from the 2026 launch wave (72151 Eevee, 72152 Pikachu and Poké Ball, 72153 Venusaur/Charizard/Blastoise). Each product asset shows packshot quality with visible merchandise. No duplicates, no text-only banners, no off-topic products. Asset count (3 products) falls within 3–5 required range. logos/brand-lego.svg is the official LEGO® wordmark lockup. The logo displays the correct iconic LEGO brand identity with white letter forms outlined in black, a yellow/gold outer ring, and the required registered trademark symbol (®). Colors match the primary palette (#E3000B red background, #FFED00 yellow, #000000 black, #FFFFFF white). This is a valid and approved brand wordmark for the LEGO® Pokémon™ collaboration campaign.
